issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): int, but the template comments and the solution implementation expect and use a double return type for getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(). This mismatch can confuse students about which return type to implement and may cause failing tests if they follow the UML instead of the template/solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across all artifacts. Recommended: update the UML in the problem statement to declare getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double and update any textual references to indicate a double return type (or alternatively change the template comment and solution to int if an integer result is desired). Ensure the instruction text (Part 2.6) and the UML match the intended double return type for precise calculation.
